# dsh-voice
Read-aloud and dictation for DSH with 23 TTS and STT providers, per-language routing and word highli
oud and dictation for DSH with 23 TTS and STT providers, per-language routing and word highlighting.

Screenshot from a demo DSH instance with sample data.
Read-aloud, dictation and language-aware speech for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI.

- A speaker on every finished assistant reply (and a `{ }` button that reads the code blocks).
- A m
icrophone in the composer, with an optional polish pass that fixes punctuation without translating.

- **Several speech providers at once**, configured in Settings > Voice, each with a Test button.
- *
*Per-language routing**: English, Italian, Greek (and any language you add) each get their own provi

der, model, voice and speed.
- **In-text language markers** to switch language mid-text.
- **Language detection** per sentence, with a DSH model for the unsure ones, and a language badge wh

ile reading.
- **Highlighting** of the sentence and the word being read, and opt-in **auto-read** of
- **Highlighting** of the sentence and the word being read, and opt-in **auto-read** of new replies.
- A **TTS Reader** sidebar tab, push-to-talk **dictation** at the composer cursor, and **keyboard sh
Reader** sidebar tab, push-to-talk **dictation** at the composer cursor, and **keyboard shortcuts**.
Status: 2.0.0. 23 provider types, EU vendors first; see CHANGELOG.md. Runs on DSH 0.2.x (tested on 0
## Install
Install from npm: `dsh plugin --profile web add @lucagiftzek/dsh-voice`, or from GitHub: `dsh plugin
--profile web add github:lucagiftzek/dsh-voice`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` lists it in the profile bundles; restart `dsh
web` to load the host half. `lib/` is committed, so no build step is needed. From a checkout instea
d: `git clone https://github.com/lucagiftzek/dsh-voice`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PW
D/dsh-voice`. Then open Settings > Voice, add a provider and press Test.
## Providers
[该节后续省略]
#### OpenAI-compatible (`openai-compatible`)
Any server with the OpenAI audio shape: /v1/audio/speech and /v1/audio/transcriptions (Groq, Kokoro-
FastAPI, Speaches, LocalAI, OVHcloud).
Residency: Depends on the endpoint: self-hosted servers keep audio on your machine, OpenAI EU and OV
Hcloud are EU-processed, Groq is US only. STT languages: any. Presets: Groq (whisper), OpenAI, OpenA
I EU (data residency, needs approval), Kokoro-FastAPI (self-hosted), Speaches / faster-whisper-serve
r (self-hosted), LocalAI (self-hosted), openedai-speech (self-hosted, TTS), OVHcloud AI Endpoints (w
hisper). Credential: the key the server expects (leave empty and tick `keyless` for a local server).
Presets fill in the base URL: Kokoro-FastAPI (word timings through its captioned speech route, no G
reek), Speaches, LocalAI, openedai-speech, Groq (speech to text), OVHcloud AI Endpoints.
Verification: Checked 2026-10-31. Confirmed from the vendor docs: OpenAI audio request shapes and th
e EU data residency host eu.api.openai.com (developers.openai.com data-residency table); Kokoro-Fast
API README (default port 8880, /v1/audio/voices, response_format and speed, POST /dev/captioned_spee
ch with base64 audio and timestamps [{word,start_time,end_time}], voice names whose first letter is
the language, languages English US/GB, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Brazilian Portugue
se, Mandarin; Greek is NOT supported); Speaches README and usage pages (OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/
speech and /v1/audio/transcriptions, Kokoro and Piper TTS, faster-whisper STT, default port 8000; it
s voice list route is marked TODO in its docs so the voice list falls back to options.voices); opene
dai-speech README (tts-1 via Piper, tts-1-hd via XTTS, port 8000, project marked obsolete by its aut
hor); LocalAI docs list GET /v1/audio/voices and /v1/audio/speech on port 8080; OVHcloud AI Endpoint
s catalogue lists whisper-large-v3 and whisper-large-v3-turbo as speech-to-text models behind the ba
se URL https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1. Unverified: that OVHcloud serves /audio/tra
https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1. Unverified: that OVHcloud serves /audio/tra [长行截断]
#### Self-hosted (ElevenLabs-compatible) (`elevenlabs-compatible`)
Any server speaking the ElevenLabs request shape (preset: Local TTS server, a loopback server with a
native /api/tts route).
Residency: Self-hosted: data stays wherever the server runs TTS languages: any. STT languages: any.
Presets: Local TTS server, Generic ElevenLabs-compatible server. Credential: the server key. The Loc
al TTS server preset points at a loopback server (`http://127.0.0.1:8771`).
Verification: Verified against a self-hosted reference server (Kokoro and Whisper behind native and
ElevenLabs-shaped routes). Other servers with this shape are untested.
## Privacy
- **No audio is stored.** The host keeps nothing: audio and transcripts pass through memory only, te
mporary files made for conversion are deleted in a `finally`, and logs carry the route, provider, st
atus, character count and duration, never text or audio. The only way audio leaves the page for disk
is **Download audio** in the TTS Reader, which you trigger yourself (`privacy.storeAudio` and `priv

acy.logTranscripts` stay off).
- Language detection sends only the unsure sentences of a message to

the DSH model chosen in Settings; its cache holds a hash, not the text.
- **Which providers leave th
e EU.** Each row shows its residency: the *EU* group (EU company, EU processing) and the *self-hoste
d* group keep data in the EU or on your machine; *EU region available* means a non-EU company with E
U regions (Azure, Google, Amazon, ElevenLabs on its residency plan, OpenAI on its EU project): choos
e the EU region explicitly, the region is part of the instance and shown in the row; *outside the EU
* (DashScope, Cartesia, Fish, and any provider left on its default US endpoint) receives the text or
audio you send it; MiMo's Token Plan host is in Amsterdam but its residency terms are not published
, so treat it as outside the EU. Chrome's live speech recognition (`dictation.liveInterim`, off by d

efault) sends audio to Google.
- Keys typed in Settings are kept in the plugin's own 0600 `vault.jso
n`, never in a settings file, and are shown as `__set__`.
